text.feels_intro: How {name}'s pinch marks feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: small, bright red pinch marks on {his} cheeks and the edge of {his} jaw, the skin flushed and slightly puffy where fingers twisted it.
{name}'s face: plum-colored bruises the size of fingertips dot {his} cheeks and chin, paired crescents of nail marks pressed into the skin, and a dark blood blister swelling beneath one cheekbone.

{name}'s face: the skin of {his} cheeks is torn in ragged little rips where it was twisted, weeping blood; deep, blood-filled bruises have puffed {his} face lopsided and half closed one eye. {name} smells of sweat and blood.
{name}'s face: the torn spots have crusted into small dark scabs, the blood blisters have dried to brown spots, and the bruising around them has faded to mottled yellow-green.
{name}'s face: the scabs are gone, leaving small patches of shiny pink new skin and faint brownish shadows where the bruises were.
{name}'s face: only a faint trace remains, a tiny pale mark near the jaw that most people would never notice.
body: {name}'s back: red pinch marks scatter across {his} sides and the soft skin over {his} ribs, each one a small raised blotch. {name} smells of fresh sweat.
{name}'s back and sides: clusters of fingertip bruises in purple and red, rows of nail crescents pressed into the skin, and a few dark blood blisters along {his} flanks. {name} smells of sweat.

{name}'s back and torso: large patches of skin twisted until they tore, leaving raw, bleeding rips; the bruises have merged into swollen, blood-filled purple-black swellings across {his} sides. The coppery smell of blood and sour sweat clings to {him}.
{name}'s back and sides: dark scabs cover the torn places and the dried blood blisters, ringed by bruising fading from purple to green and yellow.
{name}'s back and sides: blotchy pink new skin where the tears were, and faded brownish spots where the bruises sat.
{name}'s back: the marks have faded away; at most a few faint, slightly darker spots remain along {his} sides.
arm: {name}'s {part}: red pinch marks on the soft inside of the upper arm and the back of the forearm, the skin blotchy and warm.
{name}'s {part}: fingertip bruises in dark purple pairs along the inner arm, deep nail crescents pressed into the skin, and a swollen blood blister near the elbow.
{name}'s {part}: the thin skin of the inner arm is torn in several places where it was wrenched and twisted, bleeding in slow trickles; deep blood-filled bruises have swollen the arm thick and tight.
{name}'s {part}: small dark scabs over the torn spots and dried brown blood blisters, surrounded by fading yellow-green bruising.
{name}'s {part}: small patches of pink new skin and faint brownish shadows along the inner arm.
{name}'s {part}: the marks are gone; a faint pale fleck on the inner arm is all that is left.
leg: {name}'s {part}: red pinch marks on the thigh and the tender skin of the inner thigh, each one a small, raised, angry blotch.
{name}'s {part}: purple fingertip bruises in clusters up the inner thigh, nail crescents pressed deep into the skin, and dark blood blisters where the flesh was twisted hardest.
{name}'s {part}: the skin of the inner thigh is torn open in ragged rips that bleed down toward the knee; the thigh is swollen with deep, blood-filled bruises gone almost black.
{name}'s {part}: dark scabs over the torn skin, dried blood blisters, and bruising faded to yellow-green across the inner thigh.
{name}'s {part}: patches of shiny pink new skin and faint brownish spots up the inner thigh; the swelling is gone.
{name}'s {part}: the marks have faded to nothing more than a faint, slightly paler spot on the inner thigh.

head: {name}'s cheeks sting with a hot, nipping smart that lingers after the fingers let go. {name} feels belittled and indignant, rubbing at the spots as {he} speaks.
{name}'s face throbs in tight little points of pain, and the blood blister aches whenever {he} moves {his} mouth. {name} is humiliated and angry, keeping {his} face stiff and turned slightly away.

{name}'s face is a mass of raw, throbbing pain where the skin tore, the swelling pulsing with {his} heartbeat. {name} is shaken and close to tears or rage, speaking thickly through a face that hurts to move.
{name}'s face is sore and itches where the scabs sit, and the bruises ache when touched. {name} is self-conscious, keeping {his} expressions small.
{name}'s face is only tender in small spots when pressed. {name} flinches if anyone's fingers come near {his} cheek.
{name}'s face feels normal again. A hand near {his} cheek brings back a quiet memory of the pinching.
body: {name}'s sides sting in hot little points, each one nipping again as clothing brushes it. {name} is startled and irritated, holding {his} arms close to {his} body.
{name}'s sides and back ache in throbbing clusters, the blood blisters tight and sore under {his} clothes. {name} is resentful and on edge, twisting away whenever anyone comes close.

{name}'s sides and back are raw, tearing pain where the skin ripped, and the swollen bruises throb with every breath. {name} is wretched and shaking, hunched and breathing shallowly to keep {his} ribs still.
{name}'s sides itch and pull where the scabs sit, and the fading bruises ache when {he} twists or bends. {name} is weary and guarded, moving carefully.
{name}'s sides are only tender in a few spots when pressed. {name} still tenses when someone reaches toward {his} ribs.
{name}'s back and sides feel normal again. A hand on {his} side can still bring back a quiet memory of the pinching.
arm: {name}'s {part} stings in sharp little nips that fade to a warm smart. {name} is annoyed and wary, rubbing the arm and keeping it out of reach.
{name}'s {part} throbs in tight, bruised points along the inner arm, and the blood blister aches when {he} bends the elbow. {name} is sullen and guarding, holding the arm close against {his} side.
{name}'s {part} is raw, burning pain where the skin tore, the swollen arm throbbing deep and tight. {name} is miserable and shaking, unwilling to bend it or let anything touch it.
{name}'s {part} is sore and itches under the scabs, and the bruises ache when {he} grips or lifts. {name} is impatient with it, favoring the other arm.
{name}'s {part} is only tender in small spots when bumped. {name} uses it normally, but pulls it back from a grasping hand.
{name}'s {part} feels normal again. The memory of those fingers comes back quietly if someone grabs {his} arm.
leg: {name}'s {part} stings hot in small, nipping points up the thigh. {name} is flustered and irritated, shifting {his} weight and pressing {his} legs together.
{name}'s {part} throbs in bruised clusters along the inner thigh, the blood blisters chafing with every step. {name} is humiliated and tense, walking a little stiffly with {his} legs apart.

{name}'s {part} is raw, tearing pain where the skin of the inner thigh ripped, the swollen bruises throbbing deep with every step. {name} is shaken and miserable, limping and flinching whenever cloth rubs the leg.
{name}'s {part} is sore and itches under the scabs, and the fading bruises ache after walking. {name} is weary of it, sitting carefully and avoiding tight clothing.
{name}'s {part} is only tender in a few spots when pressed. {name} walks normally but still tenses when a hand comes near {his} thigh.
{name}'s {part} feels normal again. A hand on {his} thigh can still bring back a quiet memory of the pinching.

levels: , fingers and nails seizing a fold of skin and twisting it. The sharp, nipping smart catches {him} off guard, a hot little burst of pain that makes {him} jerk and gasp as it fades to a stinging throb.
right on skin that is already bruised. The nails dig into tender flesh and twist, turning a dull ache into a bright, tight spike of pain that makes {him} hiss and squirm to pull away.

, nails digging into swollen, blood-blistered flesh and wrenching it. The bruises burst with fresh pain, a deep, sickening throb that drives a cry from {him} and leaves {him} shaking. The smell of sweat rises from {him}.

, and the skin is already torn and swollen. The fingers wrench raw, ruined flesh, tearing it open again; the pain is so sharp and total that {he} goes rigid, cold sweat breaking out, {his} breath coming in broken sobs as {his} body tries to fold away from it.

stage.medium: The torn skin on {name}'s {part} has closed, leaving deep, dark bruises and blood blisters.
stage.light: The bruises on {name}'s {part} have faded to sore red pinch marks.
stage.recovering: The marks on {name}'s {part} have scabbed and dried, the bruises turning yellow-green.
stage.mostly_healed: The scabs on {name}'s {part} have fallen away, leaving pink new skin and faint brown shadows.
stage.healed: The last traces on {name}'s {part} have faded away; those pinch marks have fully healed.

heal.source_healed: All of {name}'s pinch marks have healed.
heal.passive: {text} This is only {his} body's ordinary healing; the people of Skyrim mend quickly, and nobody would think it worth remarking on.
